Adapt Raspberry Pi OS for Rugix.

## Inputs

No artifact inputs.

## Scheduling

| Setting      | Value                                                       |
| ------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------- |
| Priority     | `0`                                                         |
| Dependencies | `rugix-ctrl`, `rpi-raspios-cleanup`, `persist-fake-hwclock` |

Higher priorities run first within the selected recipe set. Dependencies include
other recipes; their priorities determine execution order.

## Behavior

Combines Rugix Ctrl installation, Raspberry Pi OS cleanup, and fake-hwclock
persistence through recipe dependencies. Use it when extending an imported
Raspberry Pi OS layer.

## Example

For example, add the recipe to a layer derived from a compatible base:

```toml
recipes = ["core/rpi-raspios-setup"]
```
